verses.en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.sm: Amuia e ua sao l o latou ala, o e savavali i le tulafono a Ieova.

verses.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
verses.sm: Amuia i latou o e tausi i ana tulafono, o e sailiili ia te ia ma le loto atoa;

verses.en: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.sm: e le faia foi e i latou se mea leaga; e savavali i latou i ona ala.

verses.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.sm: O oe lava na e poloai mai ia matuā tausiusi i au feau.

verses.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.sm: E! Fia faatatauina o‘u ala, ina ia ou tausi i au tulafono.

verses.en: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ona ou le mā lava lea, pe a a‘u manatu i au poloaiga uma.

verses.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.sm: Ou te vivii atu ia te oe ma le loto faamaoni, pe a a‘a‘oina a‘u i au faamasinoga tonu.

verses.en: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.sm: Ou te tausi i au tulafono; aua lava e te matuā lafoai mai ia te au.

verses.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
verses.sm: E faapefea ea ona faamamāina e le taulealea o lona ala? Ona ua tausi i ai e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ua ou saili ia te oe ma lo‘u loto atoa; aua ne‘i ou sese i au poloaiga.

verses.en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.sm: Ua ou teu i lo‘u loto lau afioga, ina ne‘i ou agasala ia te oe.

verses.en: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
verses.sm: Ia faafetaia oe, Ieova e; ia e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.sm: Ua ou ta‘u atu i o‘u laugutu o faamasinoga uma o lou fofoga.

verses.en: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.sm: Ua ou fiafia lava i le ala o au tulafono, e sili i le oloa uma lava.

verses.en: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.sm: Ou te mafaufau lava i au feau, ma ou manatua lava ou ala.

verses.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.sm: Ou te fiafia lava a‘u i au tulafono; e le galo ia te au o lau afioga.

verses.en: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.sm: Ia e agalelei mai i lau auauna, ia ola ai a‘u ma tausi i lau afioga.

verses.en: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.sm: Ia e faapupula mai o‘u mata, ia ou vaai lava i mea e ofo ai i lau tulafono.

verses.en: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.sm: O le tagata ese a‘u nei i le lalolagi; aua le nanā ia te au o au poloaiga.

verses.en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.sm: Ua nutimomoia lo‘u loto i le manao tele i au faamasinoga i aso uma.

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ua e aoai atu i e faamaualuga, o e ua faafanoina, o e sese i au poloaiga.

verses.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.sm: Ia e ave ese ia te au le luma ma le inosia; auā ua ou anaana i au tulafono.

verses.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.sm: Sa nonofo lava alii ma fai upu ia te au; a ua mafaufau lau auauna i au tulafono.

verses.en: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
verses.sm: O au tulafono o lo‘u lava fiafia ia, o a‘u faipule lava ia.

verses.en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.sm: Ua pipii atu lo‘u ola i le efuefu; ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.sm: Ua ou ta‘u atu o‘u ala; na e tali mai foi ia te au; ia e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.sm: Ia e faailoa mai ia te au le ala o au feau; ona ou mafaufau lea i ou vavega.

verses.en: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.sm: Ua sisina ifo o‘u loimata ona o le faanoanoa; ia e faamalosia a‘u e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.sm: Ia e faatea ese ia te au le ala o le pepelo; ma ia e foai mai lau tulafono ia te au i le alofa.

verses.en: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
verses.sm: Ua ou filifili i le ala o le faamaoni; ua ou tuuina au faamasinoga i o‘u luma.

verses.en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
verses.sm: Ua ou pipii atu i au tulafono; Ieova e, aua e te faamaina a‘u.

verses.en: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.sm: Ou te momo‘e i le ala o au poloaiga, pe a e foaiina mai ia te au le loto matala.

verses.en: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ia e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i le ala o au tulafono, ona ou anaana lava lea i ai seia oo i le gataaga.

verses.en: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.sm: Ia e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au, ona ou anaana lea i lau tulafono, ma ou tausia ma lo‘u loto atoa.

verses.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.sm: Ia e ta‘ita‘iina atu a‘u i le ala o au poloaiga; auā ou te fiafia lava i ai.

verses.en: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.sm: Ia e faauai atu lo‘u loto i au tulafono, a e aua ne‘i i le matapeapea.

verses.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.sm: Ia e liliueseina o‘u mata ne‘i ou vaai i mea le aoga; ia e faaolaolaina a‘u i lou ala.

verses.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
verses.sm: Ia e faatumauina lau afioga i lau auauna, o le ua mata‘u ia te oe.

verses.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
verses.sm: Ia e liliueseina lo‘u luma ou te fefe ai; auā e lelei au faamasinoga.

verses.en: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua ou naunau lava i au feau; ia e faaolaola mai ia te au i lau amiotonu.

verses.en: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.sm: Ia oo mai foi ia te au lou alofa, Ieova e, o lau olataga, e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.sm: Ona ou tali atu lea se upu i lē faalumaina a‘u; auā ou te faatuatua i lau afioga.

verses.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.sm: Aua foi e te matuā aveesea le upu moni i lo‘u gutu; auā ua ou faamoemoe i au faamasinoga.

verses.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.sm: Ona ou tausi lea e le aunoa lau tulafono e faavavau faavavau lava.

verses.en: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.sm: Ou te savali foi i le mea lautele; auā ua ou saili i au feau.

verses.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.sm: Ou te tautala foi i au tulafono i luma o tupu; ou te le mā ai lava.

verses.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.sm: Ou te fiafia lava a‘u i au poloaiga, ua ou naunau i ai.

verses.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.sm: Ou te sii foi i luga o‘u lima i au poloaiga ua ou naunau i ai; ou te mafaufau lava i au tulafono.

verses.en: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.sm: Ia e manatua lau afioga i lau auauna, auā ua e faatupuina lo‘u faamoemoe.

verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.sm: O le faamatalaloto lea ia te au i lo‘u puapuaga; auā o lau afioga ua faaolaolaina ai a‘u.

verses.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
verses.sm: Ua matuā tauemu mai ia te au o e faamaualuga; ou te lei liliu ese i lau tulafono.

verses.en: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ua ou manatu i au faamasinoga talu anamua, ona faamafanafanaina ai lea o a‘u.

verses.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.sm: Ua maua a‘u e le tiga tele ona o e amio leaga, e ua lafoaiina lau tulafono.

verses.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.sm: O au tulafono ua fai ia ma‘u pese i le fale ou te āumau ai.

verses.en: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ua ou manatu i lou suafa i le po, ma ou tausi i lau tulafono.

verses.en: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.sm: Ua ia te au lena mea, auā ua ou anaana i au feau.

verses.en: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.sm: Ieova e, o lo‘u tofi lava oe, ua ou fai atu, Ou te tausi i au afioga.

verses.en: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.sm: Ua ou faatoga atu i ou luma ma lo‘u loto atoa; ia e alofa mai ia te au e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.sm: Na ou manatunatu i o‘u ala, ona liliu atu lava lea o‘u vae i au tulafono.

verses.en: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ua ou faatelevave, ou te lei faatelegese ona tausi i au poloaiga.

verses.en: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.sm: Ua siomia a‘u i mailei a e amio leaga; ua le galo ia te au o lau tolafono.

verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.sm: Ou te ala i le tulua o po e vivii atu ai ia te oe, ona o au faamasinoga tonu.

verses.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.sm: Ua matou uo ma i latou uma o e matatau ia te oe, ma e ua tausi i au feau.

verses.en: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ua tumu le lalolagi i lou alofa; ia e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ua e agalelei mai i lau auauna, e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ia e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i le faautauta lelei ma le poto; auā ua ou faamaoni i au poloaiga.

verses.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.sm: A o lei puapuagatia a‘u na ou sese; a o lenei, ua ou tausi i lau afioga.

verses.en: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.sm: E lelei oe, ua e agalelei foi; ia e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.sm: Ua fatu fua e e ua faamaualuga le tala pepelo ia te au; o a‘u, ou te anaana i au feau ma lo‘u loto atoa.

verses.en: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
verses.sm: Ua lololo o latou loto e pei o le ga‘o; o a‘u, ou te olioli lava i lau tulafono.

verses.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.sm: O le mea e lelei ai a‘u ina ua puapuagatia a‘u, ina ia a‘oa‘oina ai a‘u i au tulafono.

verses.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.sm: E sili ona lelei ia te au o le tulafono a lou fofoga i afe o auro ma ario.

verses.en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.sm: Na faia a‘u e ou aao, ua saunia ai foi a‘u; ia e faalotomatala mai ia te au, ina ia a‘oa‘oina lava a‘u i au poloaiga.

verses.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.sm: O e matatau ia te oe latou te iloa mai a‘u, ona fiafia lea o i latou; auā ua ou faamoemoe i lau afioga.

verses.en: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ua ou iloa e tonu lava au faamasinoga, na e faapuapuagatia foi a‘u i le faamaoni.

verses.en: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.sm: Ia fai lou alofa ma faamatalaloto ia te au, e tusa ma lau afioga i lau auauna.

verses.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
verses.sm: Ia oo mai ia te au ou alofa mutimuti vale, ia ou ola ai; auā o lau tulafono, o lo‘u fiafia lea.

verses.en: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.sm: Ia masiasi o e faamaualuga, auā ua latou faapiopio fua mai ia te au; o a‘u, ou te mafaufau i au feau.

verses.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.sm: Ia faasaga mai ia te au o e matatau ia te oe, atoa ma e ua iloa au tulafono.

verses.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.sm: Ia sao lava lo‘u loto i au tulafono, ina ia ou le mā lava.

verses.en: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
verses.sm: Ua lailoa lava a‘u i le manao i le olataga mai ia te oe; ou te faamoemoe foi i lau afioga.

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.sm: O le a avea o‘u mata i le vaai atu i lau afioga, o loo ou faapea atu, E te faamafanafana ai ea afea ia te au?

verses.en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.sm: E ui ina avea a‘u pei o se fagupa‘u i le asu, ua le galo ia te au au tulafono.

verses.en: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.sm: E fia ea aso o lau auauna? E te faia ea afea le faamasinoga i e saua mai ia te au?

verses.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
verses.sm: O e faamaualuga, ua latou elia lua mo a‘u, ua le tusa lea ma lau tulafono.

verses.en: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.sm: O au poloaiga uma e faamaoni lava ia; e saua fua mai i latou ia te au; ia e fesoasoani mai ia te au.

verses.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.sm: Ua toe ina latou faaumatia a‘u i le nuu; a o a‘u, ou te le lafoaiina au feau.

verses.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.sm: Ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma lou alofa, ona ou tausi lava lea i le tulafono a lou fofoga.

verses.en: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ua mausali lau afioga i le lagi e faavavau lava.

verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.sm: E au tupulaga lou faamaoni; na e faatumauina le lalolagi, ona tumau lea.

verses.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
verses.sm: O lau pule o loo tumau ai ia mea i le aso nei; auā o au auauna ia mea uma lava.

verses.en: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.sm: Ana le avea lau tulafono mo‘u fiafia, po ua ou fano i lo‘u puapuaga.

verses.en: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.sm: E le galo ia te au au feau e faavavau; auā o mea ia na e faaolaola mai ai ia te au.

verses.en: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.sm: O ia te oe a‘u nei, ia e faaola mai ia te au; auā ua ou saili i au feau.

verses.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.sm: Ua lamalama o e amio leaga latou te fasioti ia te au; ua ou mafaufau i au tulafono.

verses.en: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.sm: Ua ou vaaia le iuga o mea uma ua atoatoa ona lelei; o lau poloaiga e matuā lautele lea.

verses.en: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.sm: Ua tele lava lo‘u naunau i lau tulafono; ou te mafaufau i ai i le aso atoa.

verses.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.sm: O au poloaiga e sili ai ona poto o a‘u i e ita mai ia te au; auā e ia te au lava ia e faavavau.

verses.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.sm: Ua sili ona atamai o a‘u i e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au uma lava; auā o au tulafono ou te mafaufau i ai.

verses.en: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.sm: O lo‘u lotomatala ua sili i e toeaina, auā ua ou anaana i au feau.

verses.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.sm: Ua ‘alo ese o‘u vae i ala leaga uma lava, ina ia ou tausi i lau afioga.

verses.en: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.sm: Ou te lei alu ese i au faamasinoga, auā ua e a‘oa‘o mai oe ia te au.

verses.en: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.sm: Ua matuā suamalie au afioga i lo‘u gutu; ua sili i lo le meli i lo‘u gutu.

verses.en: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.sm: O au feau ou te maua ai le lotomatala; o le mea lea ou te ‘ino‘ino ai i ala pepelo uma lava.

verses.en: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.sm: O lau afioga o le sulu lea i o‘u vae, ma le malamalama i lo‘u ala.

verses.en: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.sm: Na ou tauto, ou te faamaoni foi, ou te tausi i au faamasinoga tonu.

verses.en: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
verses.sm: Ua matuā puapuagaina a‘u; Ieova e, ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ia e talia mai lava o taulaga e faia ma le loto na fai atu ai lo‘u gutu; ma a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i au faamasinoga.

verses.en: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.sm: O i lo‘u lima lo‘u nei ola e le aunoa; a e le galo ia te au lau tulafono.

verses.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.sm: O e amio leaga ua latou faia le mailei mo a‘u; a e lei sese a‘u i au feau.

verses.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.sm: Ua fai mo‘u tofi o au tulafono e faavavau; auā o mea ia e faafiafia a‘i lo‘u loto.

verses.en: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
verses.sm: Ua uai atu lo‘u loto e fai au tulafono e faavavau faavavau lava.

verses.en: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.sm: Ou te ‘ino‘ino i e loto fetoa‘i, a ou te naunau i lau tulafono.

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.sm: O lo‘u lafitaga oe ma lo‘u talita; ou te faamoemoe i lau afioga.

verses.en: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.sm: O ese ia ia te au, outou o e amio leaga; auā ou te anaana lava i poloaiga a lo‘u Atua.

verses.en: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.sm: Ia e lagolagoina mai a‘u e tusa ma lau afioga, ina ia ou ola; aua foi ne‘i ou mā i lo‘u faamoemoega.

verses.en: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.sm: Ia e lagolagoina o a‘u, ona faaolaina lea o a‘u; ona ou faasaga lea e le aunoa i au tulafono.

verses.en: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.sm: Ua e faaleaogaina i latou uma o e sese i au tulafono; auā o le pepelo lo latou faa‘ole‘ole.

verses.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.sm: Ua e aveeseina o e amio leaga uma o i le nuu pei o le otaota o ario; o le mea lea ou te naunau ai i au tulafono.

verses.en: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.sm: Ua mogea lo‘u tino i le mata‘u ia te oe; ma ou fefe i au faamasinoga.

verses.en: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.sm: Ua ou faia le faamasinoga ma le amiotonu; aua e te tuuina atu a‘u i e saua mai ia te au.

verses.en: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.sm: Ia fai oe ma fesoasoani i lau auauna, ou te lelei ai; aua ne‘i saua mai ia te au o e faamaualuga.

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.sm: Ua avea o‘u mata i le manao i lau olataga, ma lau afioga tonu.

verses.en: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.sm: Ia e faia i lau auauna e tusa ma lou alofa; ma a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.sm: O lau auauna a‘u nei, ia e faalotomatala mai ia te au, ina ia ou iloa au tulafono.

verses.en: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.sm: Ua oo mai ona po e galue ai Ieova; ua solia e i latou lau tulafono.

verses.en: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ua sili ai lo‘u manao i au poloaiga i le auro, o le auro lelei lava.

verses.en: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te manatu ai ua tonu au feau atoa uma lava; ou te ‘ino‘ino i ala pepelo uma lava.

verses.en: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.sm: O mea e ofo ai au tulafono, o le mea lea e anaana i ai lo‘u loto.

verses.en: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.sm: O le faaalia mai o au afioga e faamalamalamaina ai; e faalotomatalaina ai e ua faigofie.

verses.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ua faamaga lo‘u gutu, ma ou ga‘ega‘e; auā ua ou naunau atu i au poloaiga.

verses.en: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.sm: Ia e liuliualo mai ia te au, ma alofa fua mai ia te au, e pei ona e masani ai i e alolofa i lou suafa.

verses.en: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.sm: Ia e faamautuina lo‘u savali i lau afioga; aua foi ne‘i manumalo mai se amio leaga e tasi ia te au.

verses.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.sm: Laveai mai ia te au i le sauaga a tagata; ona ou tausi lea i au feau.

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.sm: Ia faamalamalama mai ou fofoga i lau auauna; ma a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.sm: O loo tafe ifo o vaitafe i o‘u mata, auā e le tausi e i latou lau tulafono.

verses.en: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.sm: E amiotonu lava oe, Ieova e, ua tonu foi au faamasinoga.

verses.en: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.sm: Ua e poloai mai i au tulafono ua tonu, ma le faamaoni lava.

verses.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.sm: Ua faaumatia a‘u i lo‘u maelega, ina ua galo i e saua mai ia te au au afioga.

verses.en: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.sm: Ua se ario ua te‘a ma le otaota lau afioga; e naunau foi i ai lau auauna.

verses.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.sm: E faatauvaa lava a‘u, ma inosia; a e le galo ia te au au feau.

verses.en: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
verses.sm: O lau amiotonu o le amiotonu e faavavau lea; o le mea moni foi lau tulafono.

verses.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
verses.sm: Ua maua a‘u e le puapuaga ma le tiga; o au poloaiga ou te fiafia i ai.

verses.en: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.sm: O au tulafono o mea tonu ia e faavavau; ia e faalotomatala mai ia te au, ou te ola ai.

verses.en: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.sm: Ua ou valaau ia te oe ma le loto atoa; Ieova e, ia e tali mai ia te au; ou te anaana lava i au tulafono.

verses.en: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.sm: Ua ou valaau ia te oe; ia e faaola mai ia te au, ona ou tausi lea i au tulafono.

verses.en: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.sm: Ua muamua i le tafa o ata ona ou alaga atu; ua ou faamoemoe i lau afioga.

verses.en: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.sm: Ua muamua ona pupula o‘u mata i leoleoga i itupo, ina ia ou mafaufau i lau afioga.

verses.en: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.sm: Ia e faafofoga mai i lo‘u leo e tusa ma lou alofa; Ieova e, ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma lau faamasinoga.

verses.en: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.sm: O loo faalatalata mai e ua tausisi i amio leaga; e vava mamao i latou ma lau tulafono.

verses.en: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
verses.sm: Ua latalata mai oe Ieova e; o au poloaiga uma foi e moni lava ia.

verses.en: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.sm: Talu anamuā ua ou iloa ai au tulafono, ua e faavaeina ia e faavavau.

verses.en: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.sm: Silasila mai ia i lo‘u tiga, ma ia e laveai mai ia te au; auā e le galo ia te au lau tulafono.

verses.en: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.sm: Ia e faia la‘u finauga, ma laveai mai ia te au; ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.sm: E vava mamao le faaolataga ma i latou o e amio leaga; auā e le saili i latou i au tulafono.

verses.en: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ua tele lou alofa mutimuti vale; ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma au faamasinoga.

verses.en: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.sm: E toatele o e saua mai ma ita mai ia te au; ou te le liliu ese lava i au tulafono.

verses.en: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.sm: Na ou iloa atu i e ua faa‘ole‘ole, ma ou ‘ino‘ino i ai, o i latou o e le tausi i lau afioga.

verses.en: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.sm: Ia e silasila mai ua ou naunau i au feau; Ieova e, ia e faaolaola mai ia te au e tusa ma lou alofa.

verses.en: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.sm: E moni lava lau afioga talu le amataga; e faavavau foi au faamasinoga tonu uma lava.

verses.en: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.sm: Ua saua fua mai alii ia te au; a ua fefe lo‘u loto i au afioga.

verses.en: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.sm: Ou te fiafia a‘u i lau afioga, faapei o le ua maua le vete tele.

verses.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.sm: Ou te ‘ino‘ino i le tala pepelo, ou te matuā ‘ino‘ino i ai; a ou te naunau i lau tulafono.

verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.sm: E ta‘i foi faafitu i aso ona ou vivii atu ia te oe, ona o au faamasinoga tonu.

verses.en: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.sm: Ua tele le filemu o e naunau i lau tulafono; e leai foi se mea e tausuai ai i latou.

verses.en: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ua ou faamoemoe i lau olataga, ma a‘u faia au poloaiga.

verses.en: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.sm: Ua tausi au tulafono i lo‘u loto; ma ou matuā naunau i ai.

verses.en: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.sm: Ua ou tausi i au feau, atoa ma au tulafono; auā o i ou luma o‘u ala uma lava.

verses.en: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ia oo atu la‘u alaga i ou luma; ia e faalotomatala mai ia te au, e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.sm: Ia oo atu i ou luma la‘u aioi atu; ia e laveai mai ia te au, e tusa ma lau afioga.

verses.en: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.sm: E ta‘u atu le viiga i o‘u laugutu, pe a e a‘oa‘o mai ia te au i au tulafono.

verses.en: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.sm: E tautala lo‘u laulaufaiva i lau afioga, auā ua tonu au poloaiga uma lava.

verses.en: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.sm: Ia fesoasoani mai lou aao ia te au; auā ua ou filifilia au feau.

verses.en: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
verses.sm: Ieova e, ou te naunau i lau faaolataga; o lau tulafono foi, o lo‘u lea fiafia.

verses.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.sm: Ia ola lava a‘u, ina ia ou vivii atu ia te oe; ia fesoasoani mai foi au faamasinoga ia te au.

verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.sm: Ua ou alu ese faapei o le mamoe ua sē; ia e saili mai i lau auauna; auā ua le galo ia te au au poloaiga.
